The immediate competitive threat is aggressive entry pricing eroding price-sensitive SMB accounts. Memory_73 demonstrates that targeted promotional pricing is effective in the SMB segment with strong acquisition lift, and the four-week reporting cadence is aligned with our weekly experiment window. Verifying memory_31 and memory_73 will confirm the magnitude of prior SMB segment response and whether pricing elasticity remains favorable.
